title: Trailer says no verifier ran for jobs rejected by a check
summary: Review note n2 says a job rejected by a check before any verifier ran still gets `Athena-Verifier: <model> fail`, which reads as if the verifier judged it. The closing commit should carry `Athena-Verifier: none (check <name> failed)` instead. The audience is anyone reading a job's commit trailers.

defaults_applied.how: Add unit tests, with cargo test and clippy passing.
Choose the trailer by whether a verifier invocation exists, not just by the verdict.
Update docs/records.md so outside readers can interpret the trailer.
Tests assert the actual trailer values.
One focused change in run.rs and docs/records.md.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: In run.rs (~line 1476-1488) the trailer is emitted from final_verdict whenever a verification exists, whatever Verification.verifier_invocation says. That is the root cause.
A verifier ran if and only if verification.verifier_invocation is Some.
With no verifier run, the first failed check in verification.checks (passed == false) names the check. If none failed, the form falls back to `none (no verifier ran)`.
Several failed checks: name the first, or join the names with commas. Either is acceptable if documented.
The extraction of trailer construction into a small pure function is allowed so it can be unit tested.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new unit test in athena-core builds the closing trailers for a verification with verifier_invocation None and a failed check named fmt. It asserts the Athena-Verifier value is exactly `none (check fmt failed)` and does not contain the verifier model name. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
A test asserts that when verifier_invocation is Some, the trailer is still `<verifier-model> pass` for a pass verdict and `<verifier-model> fail` for a fail verdict. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
In crates/athena-core/src/run.rs the Athena-Verifier trailer is chosen by whether a verifier invocation exists. The model name appears only when a verifier ran.
docs/records.md documents the `Athena-Verifier: none (check <name> failed)` form beside the `<model> pass` line, so a reader of a rejected job's commit can tell that no verifier judged it.
The change is focused. No governance files change. CHANGELOG.md gets an entry only if the repo's convention requires one.

out_of_scope: Changing how verdicts are computed or recorded in verification.json
Changing the gate's reading of records
